entries.english:
Factory work regulations

Including, among other things, a booklet “Work Regulations of the J.F. Rosenberg Company, Hohenlimburg”; a booklet “Work Regulations for the Rudolf Kersberg Factory, Hohenlimburg”; a booklet “Work Regulations for Karl Fritzler’s Factory in Hohenlimburg”; a booklet “Work Regulations of the Winterhager & Romberg Company, Hohenlimburg”; a booklet “Work Regulations for the C.D. Wälzholz Factory in Hohenlimburg”; a booklet “Work Regulations of the Ch.A. Fißmer Company”; a booklet “Work Regulations of the Moritz Ribbert Company”; a booklet “Work Regulations of the Vereinigte Walz- u. Röhrenwerke A.G., formerly Friedr. Boecker Ph¿s Sohn & Co and Friedr. König”; and a booklet “Work Regulations for the Hoesch Iron and Steel Works, Limburger Fabrik- und Hüttenverein division in Hohenlimburg.”
